title: 有馬記念の後に・『最強』

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: We have our winner! The top runner is none other than Mihono Bouuurbooon!
Wooooo!
Thunderous applause fills the air as Mihono Bourbon crosses the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon's number one!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Bourbon! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Checking… feelings. Analysis… unclear.
She looks up at the stands with tears running down her face.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Th-these tears won't stop. I cannot find the cause and need immediate assistance—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is this what "happiness" feels like?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Sniff.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Reporting. I… I won!
The applause at the racecourse continues until Mihono Bourbon's tears finally stop.
The next day, Mihono Bourbon's victory is all over the news.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Mihono Bourbon scored a stunning victory at the hotly contested Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There are interviews with spectators included below.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "She started out as a sprinter, but she's been training her hardest every single day!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "She proved that stamina can be supplemented through hard work."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Watching her do her best made me want to work harder too!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "The spectators who were interviewed all spoke passionately about Mihono Bourbon."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Everyone was skeptical of her chances at first, and we have to admit that we, as journalists, were no different."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "But she proved us all wrong when she won this 2,500-meter race that was packed with the best of the best."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "No one can stand in her way now."
Mihono Bourbon stares intently at the article she's reading.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, do you think I've completed my mission?
After telling her about how her running has inspired people of all backgrounds, she smiles bashfully at me.
After telling her about how her running has inspired people of all backgrounds, she smiles bashfully at me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I feel great "pride."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, I'm ready for your next request.
With that, we head out for a run on the track.
